items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Budj' (Budd Johnson) in the context of a previous band, but the interviewee corrects the record, stating 'no, this was one when I rehearsed at the Sunset' and lists a different lineup, indicating Budd Johnson was not in the specific band being discussed and no direct person

ctx.x: Yes, he played alto. Let me see, did I have Scovell Brown?
You mentioned earlier that you had Budj--
